description: Dual Gemmini cycle and compute-overlap measurements. Routine regression logs are not included.
scope: One Rocket CPU, two Gemmini engines, shared DDR3; 16x16 INT8 inputs and INT32 outputs.
measurement: Kernel load, compute, store and completion fence. Input preparation and verification are outside the cycle interval. First invocation and repeated-after-verification invocation are separate.

source_identity.note: Generation only. Neither RTL execution nor performance validation.

analysis.measurement: First invocation and repeated-after-verification invocation, separate cycle values.
analysis.compute_measurement: Sum of per-GEMM command-acceptance-to-completion windows in the same RTL trace; excludes data transfers and gaps between macros. Not end-to-end latency.

limitations: PE(0,0) nonzero activity is a witness of overlapping multiplication, not whole-array utilization.
This is a fixed tile-kernel experiment, not a general asynchronous scheduler or full-model performance result.
Source identity is recorded by pinned upstreams and file hashes; the final packaging commit is not the original measurement commit.
Complete RTL binaries and raw traces remain in local build directories; the file preserves the analyzed measurements.
